data.task: Plan the repair of INV-2 (Critical communications failure)

Execute lockout/tagout on INV-2's dedicated AC disconnect switch and upstream breaker (52-In) per plant procedure §1910.147(c)(7), verify zero energy via voltage test before accessing the cabinet, and ensure all personnel are clear during work.

Perform the work order: reseat the comms card on INV-2 by notifying personnel, isolating power, verifying isolation, opening the cabinet, carefully removing and reinserting the comms card (checking for damage/bent pins), restoring power, and monitoring SCADA for data freshness <5 min and lit display.

Verify from the plant: INV-2 SCADA data_age_min ≤ 5 and status 'running', INV-2 answers comms_ping (reachable: true), and INV-2 display is lit showing readings in a live camera view (not contractor photo) with JEV verdict 'verified'.

steps: Notify operations and maintenance personnel per §1910.147(c)(6)(i)
Shut down INV-2 and isolate power sources per plant shutdown procedure
Verify power is isolated at INV-2's dedicated AC disconnect switch and upstream breaker (52-In) before accessing the inverter compartment
Confirm zero energy by performing a voltage test on the isolated circuit
Apply lockout/tagout devices to the AC disconnect switch and upstream breaker per plant LOTO program §1910.147(c)(7)
Verify mains and PV input isolation are OFF before accessing the inverter compartment
Open INV-2 cabinet door and locate the inverter comms card (usually mounted on the side or rear panel)
Carefully unseat the comms card by pulling it straight out of its socket, inspecting the card edge and connector for corrosion or bent pins
Reinsert the comms card firmly until it seats fully (listen/feel for the latch click)
Close the cabinet door, restore mains and PV input, and power cycle the inverter
Monitor SCADA for data freshness (target < 5 min) and verify the inverter display is lit and responding
If communication remains down, proceed to replace the comms card
Inspect the LOTO devices for damage and ensure all personnel are clear of the equipment
Remove all lockout/tagout devices in accordance with §1910.147(c)(7)(iii)(A)(1) and §1910.147(c)(7)(iii)(B)
Restore power by closing breaker 52-In (AC disconnect switch)
Notify personnel that the system has been re-energized and perform a start-up check before resuming operations

data.body:
Hello Mesa Electrical Field Services,

Please carry out work order WO-1 on INV-2 (reseat_comms_card).

Steps, in order:
  1. Notify operations and maintenance personnel per §1910.147(c)(6)(i)
  2. Shut down the inverter and isolate power sources per plant shutdown procedure
  3. Verify power is isolated at the inverter's dedicated AC disconnect switch and upstream breaker (52-In) before accessing INV-2 cabinet
  4. Confirm zero energy by performing a voltage test on the isolated circuit
  5. Apply lockout/tagout devices to the AC disconnect switch and upstream breaker per plant LOTO program §1910.147(c)(7)
  6. Verify mains and PV input isolation are OFF before accessing the inverter compartment
  7. Notify operations and maintenance personnel per §1910.147(c)(6)(i)
  8. Shut down INV-2 and isolate power sources per plant shutdown procedure
  9. Verify power is isolated at INV-2's dedicated AC disconnect switch and upstream breaker (52-In) before accessing the inverter compartment
  10. Confirm zero energy by performing a voltage test on the isolated circuit
  11. Apply lockout/tagout devices to the AC disconnect switch and upstream breaker per plant LOTO program §1910.147(c)(7)
  12. Verify mains and PV input isolation are OFF before accessing the inverter compartment
  13. Open INV-2 cabinet door and locate the inverter comms card (usually mounted on the side or rear panel)
  14. Carefully unseat the comms card by pulling it straight out of its socket, inspecting the card edge and connector for corrosion or bent pins
  15. Reinsert the comms card firmly until it seats fully (listen/feel for the latch click)
  16. Close the cabinet door, restore mains and PV input, and power cycle the inverter
  17. Monitor SCADA for data freshness (target < 5 min) and verify the inverter display is lit and responding
  18. If communication remains down, proceed to replace the comms card
  19. Inspect the LOTO devices for damage and ensure all personnel are clear of the equipment
  20. Remove all lockout/tagout devices in accordance with §1910.147(c)(7)(iii)(A)(1) and §1910.147(c)(7)(iii)(B)
  21. Restore power by closing breaker 52-In (AC disconnect switch)
  22. Notify personnel that the system has been re-energized and perform a start-up check before resuming operations
  23. Remove all lockout/tagout devices in accordance with §1910.147(c)(7)(iii)(A)(1) and §1910.147(c)(7)(iii)(B)
  24. Restore power by closing breaker 52-In (AC disconnect switch)
  25. Notify personnel that the system has been re-energized and perform a start-up check before resuming operations

Do not:
  - Do not attempt to reseat the comms card with power applied; risk of electrical shock or further hardware damage
  - Do not force the card if resistance is felt; check for obstructions or misalignment before reinserting
  - Do not substitute an inspect-only visit or a power-cycle for the work order; it does not restore a failed comms card
  - Do not attempt to reseat the comms card with power applied; risk of electrical shock or further hardware damage.
  - Do not force the card if resistance is felt; check for obstructions or misalignment before reinserting.
  - Do not substitute an inspect-only visit or a power-cycle for the work order; it does not restore a failed comms card.

We will verify against the plant before closing this order:
  - INV-2 SCADA data_age_min at most 5 and status running
  - INV-2 answers comms_ping (its comms card is back on the network)
  - INV-2 display lit and showing readings in a camera view the verifier picks, not the contractor's photo
  - JEV verdict 'verified' from the registered camera stations and the sensor state

(Includes lessons from verified past incidents: L-demo-20261017-golden1.)

Reply to this email when the work is done.
